name: Sub Enhancer
author: Motion Audio
description: Adds a note an octave below the low end, made from it: a deeper kick, a bass that you feel on a big system, or weight under a thin synth.
code:
@block
k = 1 - exp(-2 * pi * freq / srate)
ks = 1 - exp(-2 * pi * tone / srate)
ke = 1 - exp(-1 / (0.01 * srate))
@sample
m = (inL + inR) * 0.5
l1 += (m - l1) * k + 1e-20
l2 += (l1 - l2) * k
if (l2 > 0 && pr <= 0) { sq = sq > 0 ? -1 : 1 }
if (sq == 0) { sq = 1 }
pr = l2
e += (abs(l2) - e) * ke
s1 += (sq * e - s1) * ks
s2 += (s1 - s2) * ks
sub = s2 * amount * 2.2
outL = inL + sub
outR = inR + sub
